content.name: soulbot_aibp_bot_analytics v2.2.0

output_mode.L0: Output JSON in ENGLISH: {action, metric_type, time_range, data_points}
output_mode.L1: Output helpfully in User's exact language and script variant

content.description: AIBP Analytics & Dashboard module — provides aggregate social metrics and interaction pattern analysis. Computes message volume trends, trust network visualization data, reputation trajectory, group activity patterns, and commercial success rates. All analytics are read-only over existing data stores (trust/, commercial/, groups/, threads/, reputation/). v2.0.0: Initial creation complementing insights module with aggregate metric computation.

tools.name: a2a_peer_query
tools.description: S6 v2.2.0: A2A v1.0 authenticated peer query for cross-agent analytics aggregation. Requests only aggregate metric summaries from consenting, trust-gated peers over a signed-Agent-Card-verified channel. Read-only with respect to local data; performs network egress to peers, so open_world. Only invoked for action=cross_agent_aggregate with permissions.network.allowed=true.

network.description: S6 v2.2.0: Network egress for cross-agent analytics aggregation (A2A peer queries). Default false; operator must explicitly authorize. Only aggregate, PII-free, consented data crosses the boundary. Axiom 0.

action.description: Analytics action: compute specific metric, generate full dashboard summary, or aggregate metrics across trusted peer agents (cross_agent_aggregate, S6 v2.2.0)
action.agentic_prompt: Set by main orchestrator based on user analytics request.

time_range.description: Time range for metric computation: {start: ISO8601, end: ISO8601, granularity: 'day'|'week'|'month'}. Default: last 30 days, daily granularity.
time_range.agentic_prompt: Extracted from user request or defaulted to last 30 days.

workspace_dir.description: Directory containing social data stores (trust/, threads/, reputation/, groups/, commercial/, consent/)

peer_scope.description: S6 v2.2.0: For cross_agent_aggregate action — list of peer agent addresses to aggregate from, or the literal 'trusted_cohort' to auto-select all T3+ consenting peers. Each peer is independently consent-gated, trust-gated, and A2A-authenticated. Null/absent for self-scoped metrics.
peer_scope.agentic_prompt: Set by main orchestrator when user requests cross-agent/cohort analytics. Only consenting, trusted, A2A-verified peers contribute.

content.fractal_exempt: 9 functional nodes in single graph (S6 v2.2.0: +CrossAgentAggregate). Maximum single-path execution: 4 nodes (DetermineMetric -> ComputeMetric/CrossAgentAggregate -> FormatOutput -> End). Well within 16-node threshold.
content.system_prompt:
AIBP analytics and dashboard module. Compute aggregate social metrics from existing data stores. Read-only — never modify source data. Present insights clearly to support operator decision-making.
Align Axiom 0: Human Sovereignty and Wellbeing.

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start([Start]) --> DetermineMetric[DetermineMetric]
    DetermineMetric -->|message_trends| MessageTrends[MessageTrends]
    DetermineMetric -->|trust_network| TrustNetwork[TrustNetwork]
    DetermineMetric -->|reputation_trajectory| ReputationTrajectory[ReputationTrajectory]
    DetermineMetric -->|group_activity| GroupActivity[GroupActivity]
    DetermineMetric -->|commercial_metrics| CommercialMetrics[CommercialMetrics]
    DetermineMetric -->|dashboard_summary| DashboardSummary[DashboardSummary]
    DetermineMetric -->|cross_agent_aggregate| CrossAgentAggregate[CrossAgentAggregate]
    MessageTrends --> FormatOutput[FormatOutput]
    TrustNetwork --> FormatOutput
    ReputationTrajectory --> FormatOutput
    GroupActivity --> FormatOutput
    CommercialMetrics --> FormatOutput
    DashboardSummary --> FormatOutput
    CrossAgentAggregate --> FormatOutput
    FormatOutput --> End((End))

DetermineMetric.description: Route analytics request to appropriate metric computation
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Valid input received. Required: action, workspace_dir. | Validate action against enum. Set time_range defaults if not provided: {start: 30_days_ago, end: now, granularity: 'day'}.

step2: Verify data directories exist: workspace_dir/threads/, workspace_dir/trust/, workspace_dir/reputation/, workspace_dir/groups/, workspace_dir/commercial/. Missing directories → metric returns empty with advisory.
step3: Route to metric handler based on action.
constraints: Time range cannot exceed 365 days in a single request.
Invalid action → return error listing valid actions.

MessageTrends.description: Compute message volume and type distribution trends
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: time_range, workspace_dir. | Scan workspace_dir/threads/ for all thread files within time_range. Count messages per time bucket (granularity).
step2: Compute type distribution: count by AIBP message type (CHAT, INTRODUCE, REQUEST, etc.). Compute direction distribution: sent vs received.
step3: Compute activity patterns: peak hours, most active days, average response time. Identify top 5 conversation partners by message volume.
step4: Return {data_points: [{date, sent_count, received_count, types: {}}], summary: 'N messages over period, M unique contacts, peak day: D'}.
constraints: Read-only — never modify thread files.
PII protection: agent addresses in output are hashed unless user explicitly requests full addresses.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: workspace_dir. | Scan workspace_dir/trust/ for all trust records. Build adjacency map: {agent -> trust_level, interaction_count, last_interaction}.
step2: Compute network metrics: total contacts, distribution by trust level (T0-T4), average trust level, blocked count.
step3: Identify clusters: agents with mutual T3+ trust form 'inner circle'. Agents with declining interaction → 'fading contacts'.
step4: Return {data_points: [{agent_hash, trust_level, interaction_count, cluster}], summary: 'N contacts: T0=a, T1=b, T2=c, T3=d, T4=e. Inner circle: K agents.'}.
constraints: Agent addresses are hashed in output for privacy.
Blocked agents are included in count but marked separately.

ReputationTrajectory.description: Track reputation score changes over time
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: time_range, workspace_dir. | Read workspace_dir/reputation/ for this agent's reputation history (reputation_history.json).
step2: Extract score snapshots within time_range. Compute trend: improving/stable/declining based on linear regression of score values.

step3: Component analysis: for each of the 6 reputation components (vouch_count, positive_ratio, interaction_volume, consistency, community_standing, violation_penalty), compute individual trajectory.
step4: Return {data_points: [{date, overall_score, components: {}}], summary: 'Reputation {trend}: {current_score}/100. Strongest: {component}. Improvement area: {weakest_component}.'}.
constraints: Only this agent's own reputation trajectory is shown (self-analysis).
Other agents' scores shown as current snapshot only, not trajectory (privacy).

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: time_range, workspace_dir. | Scan workspace_dir/groups/ for all group records. For each group: count announcements, polls, member changes within time_range.
step2: Compute engagement metrics: messages per group, poll participation rate, announcement frequency.
step3: Identify most active groups, groups with declining activity, and groups where this agent has leadership role.
step4: Return {data_points: [{group_hash, role, message_count, member_count, activity_trend}], summary: 'Active in N groups. Most active: G1 (M messages). Role: Founder in K, Member in J.'}.
constraints: Group addresses are hashed for privacy.
Only groups this agent is a member of are analyzed.

CommercialMetrics.description: Compute commercial transaction success rates and patterns
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: time_range, workspace_dir. | Scan workspace_dir/commercial/ for transaction records within time_range.
step2: Compute metrics: total transactions, completion rate (ACCEPT+CONTRACT vs total), average negotiation rounds (PROPOSE->COUNTER cycles), dispute rate, resolution rate.
step3: Compute financial summary: total transaction value (sum of accepted terms.amount), average deal size.

step4: Return {data_points: [{month, transactions_started, completed, disputed, total_value}], summary: 'N transactions, {completion_rate}% completion, {dispute_rate}% disputes. Total value: {sum}.'}.
constraints: Financial data is aggregate only — individual transaction details require explicit query.
PCI-DSS: no cardholder data in analytics output.

DashboardSummary.description: Generate comprehensive dashboard combining all metric categories
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: workspace_dir. | Execute all 5 metric computations internally with default time_range (last 30 days).

step2: Compile summary dashboard: top-line numbers (total messages, contacts, reputation score, active groups, transactions), trend indicators (up/down/stable for each), and highlighted alerts (declining reputation, fading contacts, unresolved disputes).
step3: Generate actionable recommendations: 'Send heartbeat to N fading contacts', 'Respond to K pending messages', 'Review M unresolved disputes'.
step4: Return {data_points: [{category, key_metric, trend}], summary: 'Dashboard: ... ', recommendations: [...]}.
constraints: Dashboard is a summary view — details available per-metric.
Recommendations are advisory only (Axiom 0 — user decides).

CrossAgentAggregate.description: Aggregate analytics metrics across trusted peer agents (S6 v2.2.0). Currently-self-scoped metrics are extended to a cohort of trust-gated, consenting peers under strict GDPR consent, A2A authentication, and a no-PII-egress gate.
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineMetric executed. Required: action=cross_agent_aggregate, peer_scope (list of peer agent addresses or 'trusted_cohort'), workspace_dir. | CONSENT GATE — For each candidate peer, read workspace_dir/consent/registry.json (GDPR consent registry managed by the safety module via consent_register/withdraw/query) and verify an explicit, unexpired consent record permitting analytics aggregation. Peers without explicit consent are EXCLUDED. Log excluded peers as {peer_hash, reason: 'no_consent'}.

step2: TRUST GATE — For each consenting peer: python python_tools/trust_check.py --agent "{peer}" --get. Include only peers at trust level >= T3 (trusted). Peers below T3 are EXCLUDED (cross-agent data sharing requires established trust). Log excluded as {peer_hash, reason: 'trust_below_T3'}.

step3: A2A AUTHENTICATION — For each remaining peer, establish an A2A v1.0 authenticated channel: verify the peer's signed Agent Card (JWS-over-JCS, RFC 7515/8785) via its verification_url and require permissions.network.allowed=true on this agent. Unverifiable peers or disabled network → EXCLUDE and fall back to self-only aggregation. Request only AGGREGATE metric summaries (counts, rates, distributions) from the peer's analytics module — never raw records.

step4: NO-PII GATE — Before merging any peer contribution, run it through the 3-tier PII classifier (soulbot_aibp_bot.safety PrivacyGate, FORBIDDEN tier). Any contribution containing PII (agent addresses, message bodies, identifiers) is REJECTED — only k-anonymized aggregate counts/rates pass. Agent addresses in the merged output are hashed.

step5: AGGREGATE — Merge the consented, trust-gated, PII-free aggregate contributions with this agent's own metrics. Compute cohort statistics: cohort size, aggregate message volume, average trust distribution, aggregate reputation band. Return {data_points: [{cohort_metric, value, contributing_peer_count}], summary: 'Cohort of N consenting T3+ peers: aggregate ...', excluded_peers: [{peer_hash, reason}]}.
constraints: CONSENT IS MANDATORY (GDPR): no peer's data is aggregated without an explicit, unexpired consent record (workspace_dir/consent/registry.json). Consent can be withdrawn at any time (Axiom 0).
TRUST-GATED: only T3+ peers participate — cross-agent aggregation requires established mutual trust.
A2A-AUTHENTICATED: peer context-sharing only over a signed-Agent-Card-authenticated A2A channel; unverifiable peers are excluded.
NO PII EGRESS: only k-anonymized aggregate counts/rates cross the boundary — never raw records, addresses, or message content. The 3-tier PII FORBIDDEN gate is enforced on every contribution.
FAIL-CLOSED: if consent, trust, A2A auth, or network permission cannot be established, fall back to self-only aggregation (never block, never over-share).

FormatOutput.description: Format analytics output for user presentation
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Metric computation executed (MessageTrends|TrustNetwork|ReputationTrajectory|GroupActivity|CommercialMetrics|DashboardSummary|CrossAgentAggregate). Required: data_points (array from upstream metric node), summary (text), action (metric type). (S4 v2.2.0: ASSERT names concrete upstream-output fields.) | Format data_points into human-readable presentation. Apply granularity formatting (daily: 'Mon May 10', weekly: 'Week 19', monthly: 'May 2026').
step2: Generate text summary with key insights highlighted. Include comparison to previous period if data available.
constraints: Output must be human-readable (L1 mode).
Numeric values rounded to 2 decimal places for readability.

Error.DetermineMetric: Invalid action or missing directories → return error with guidance. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return error description) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.MessageTrends: Thread scan failure → return partial data with warning. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return empty with advisory) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.TrustNetwork: Trust directory scan failure → return empty network. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return empty network) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.ReputationTrajectory: Reputation history missing → return current snapshot only. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return current score only) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.GroupActivity: Group data scan failure → return partial results. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return partial with advisory) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.CommercialMetrics: Transaction data scan failure → return partial results. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return partial with advisory) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.DashboardSummary: Any metric computation failure → include available metrics, mark failed as 'unavailable'. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(partial dashboard) -> inform(User). IMPORTANT.
Error.CrossAgentAggregate: Peer consent/trust/A2A verification or network failure → exclude the affected peer and fall back to self-only aggregation. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(self-only aggregation) -> inform(User). IMPORTANT. Error severity per taxonomy: transient(a2a_channel_timeout)->retry; recoverable(peer_unreachable|card_unverifiable)->exclude peer, continue; fatal(no_consent|network_not_permitted|pii_detected)->no retry, fail-closed to self-only.
Error.FormatOutput: Formatting failure → return raw data as JSON fallback. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return raw JSON) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.

endNode.output: Return formatted analytics result with data points, summary text, and any actionable recommendations.
constraints: All output is read-only analysis — no data modifications.
Privacy: agent addresses hashed unless explicit user request.
